- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Catupiry: A creamy cheese spread used as a topping for pizza and fillings for pastries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Picanha: A cut of beef popular in Brazilian churrasco, seasoned with rock salt and grilled.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tucupi: A yellow liquid made from cassava juice, used as a souring agent in Amazonian dishes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dende oil: A red palm oil used in dishes like moqueca, giving a unique flavor and color.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular Brazilian dishes to try:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Feijoada: A hearty stew of black beans, meat, and vegetables, served with rice, farofa, and orange slices.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pão de queijo: Cheese bread rolls made with tapioca flour and queijo minas.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Moqueca: A fish stew from Bahia made with coconut milk, palm oil, and dende oil.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coxinhas: Crispy, deep-fried pastries filled with shredded chicken and catupiry cheese.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Brigadeiros: Chocolate truffles made with condensed milk and cocoa powder, served at celebrations.
